items.title: Ledger hardware implant saga reaches Dubai’s Virgin Megastore
items.snippet: Two Ledger owners reported losing a combined $604,000 in crypto from hardware wallets they said were purchased at authorized retailer Virgin Megastore in Dubai.

items.title: CFTC nominee questions public benefit of prediction markets as legal fight grows
items.snippet: One of the two picks to join the regulatory commission, Democratic nominee Matthew Rowland, said he hopes to have a say in prediction markets rulemaking.

items.title: Nvidia board rejects Huang comeback despite record $116B quarter
items.snippet: Nvidia beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations by 5.6% and issued a stronger-than-expected sales forecast, while its board resisted growing calls for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement.
